incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency SLO burn detected (US-EAST) — 12m window, p99 = 2.8s (> 2.0s threshold). Autopager triggered.
pagerduty: Pager Duty: Incident #INC-4829 fired and routed to oncall rotation (sam_oncall). Link: https://pd.example/INC-4829
sam_oncall: acked. looking now. any obvious error spikes?
maria_sre: seeing sustained queue depth increase on sidecar-proxy (req_queue > 8000). no 5xxs, just slow tail.
kevin_platform: autoscaler is flapping, nodes scaling up then down due to probe timeouts. suspect tokenization workers backing up.
anna_englead: tagging customer-impact — enterprise customers maybe affected. jeremy_ops can you pull customer-facing dashboard?
jeremy_ops: customer dashboard shows increased response time for a handful of customers on region us-east, ~1-3% errors for timeouts (client side). notifying account teams.
sam_oncall: running quick runbook steps: 1) suppress duplicate autopager. 2) try route fallback to dedicated pool for high QPS routes.
maria_sre: +1 to suppress autopager. command: ```incident-bot suppress-autopage INC-4829 10m reason="investigating flapping"```
incident-bot: Autopage suppression applied for 10m by sam_oncall.
kevin_platform: initiating manual route shift for /v1/generate heavy clients -> dedicated-pool-ea. Doing canary 10% -> 100% if stable.
sam_oncall: check logs for tokenizer backlog: ```kubectl logs tokenizer-abc -n prod | tail -n 200``` — seeing stalls at "KV cache miss" repeated.
maria_sre: kv-cache eviction rate spiked after recent config bump. reverting config now: ```kubectl apply -f revert-kv-config.yaml```
kevin_platform: revert applied, warming caches. canary traffic increased to 30%, latency down to p99=1.9s in canary.
jeremy_ops: customer ops: reached out to two affected accounts with ETA 15m. no escalations yet.
anna_englead: good. please capture root-cause notes and follow-up runbook change (kvcache threshold tuning).
sam_oncall: leaving a follow-up: open ticket ENGOPS-789 to add automatic kvcache warmup on config change, and extend autopage suppression window to 20m for flapping detection. I'll hand off to maria for postmortem.
maria_sre: I'm taking lead for postmortem. monitoring for 20m quiet window before resolve.
sam_oncall: thanks — I'll mark the PD incident as acknowledged and attach this thread. :thumbsup:
pagerduty: Incident #INC-4829 status: acknowledged by sam_oncall.
incident-bot: NOTE: No customer data exposure detected. Logging mitigation steps to incident log.
